title: Qingfeng pipeline review report
description: Independent review verdict consumed by Codex strict Structured Outputs. Every object lists every one of its properties in required and sets additionalProperties=false, recursively: the API refuses the request before inference otherwise. Optional detail is never omitted; it uses the sentinel "" (no evidence/path) or 0 (no line). A pass requires every acceptance item passed, every independent command exit 0 at the exact headSha, and no critical or important finding.

headSha.description: Must equal the verified head under review.

acceptanceResults.description: One entry per acceptance item in the frozen manifest, in order; text must be copied verbatim.

evidence.description: Concrete rerun/reference evidence; use "" only when there is genuinely nothing to cite.

findings.description: Empty when there is nothing to report.

path.description: Repository-relative file path; use "" when the finding is not tied to one file.

line.description: 1-based line number; use 0 when there is no exact line.

testEvidence.description: Rerun outputs, each bound to the reviewed headSha and the frozen manifest digest; exit 0 alone is not a pass.

specDigest.description: sha256 of the frozen task manifest this evidence is bound to.

output.description: Full captured stdout+stderr of the rerun; use "" only when the command produced no output.
